info.title: ImageTracker API
info.description: Versioned foundation contract for ImageTracker mobile, CLI, and future native Windows clients. The v1 API stores metadata for Local sources, manages exact-deduplicated originals for Remote sources, and exposes cursor-based media evidence without coupling clients to the MySQL schema.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Authenticated liveness and restricted dependency health.

tags.name: Sources
tags.description: Local or Remote media sources and source manifests.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Timeline, search, detail, and trash lifecycle.

get.description: Returns non-sensitive liveness information to an authenticated client. Dependency details are available from the restricted admin health endpoint.

post.summary: Register or refresh an app installation
post.description: The stable client installation ID makes registration safely repeatable across app restarts.

post.summary: Create a Local or Remote media source
post.description: Storage mode defaults to Local. A source belongs to exactly one registered device. Recreating a previously removed source reactivates the same source identity.

200.description: Existing compatible source returned or removed source reactivated.

patch.summary: Update source settings or storage mode
patch.description: Changing Local to Remote schedules missing originals for upload. Changing Remote to Local affects future uploads only and does not delete cloud copies.

delete.description: Marks the source removed. Assets enter trash only when their final occurrence is removed.

post.summary: Submit a batch of source occurrence changes
post.description: Upserts occurrence metadata and links exact duplicates. Deletions are applied only when the client explicitly declares deletion detection reliable; permission loss, limited access, or an unreadable source is never interpreted as deletion.

The server checks the per-user SHA-256 identity and upload lease before returning any signed upload URL. Media bytes never pass through the API. Local sources return LocalOnly for permanent Original/Preview purposes, but may receive a one-day staging upload for TemporaryProcessing when an eligible processingJobId is authorized.

200.description: Upload plan created or duplicate detected.

get.description: Returns the authoritative uploaded-part list and current lease state after an app restart or interrupted transfer.

post.description: Issues fresh URLs only for requested unfinished part numbers while preserving the original upload lease and provider upload ID.

200.description: Fresh signed URLs for unfinished requested parts.

post.summary: Complete and verify a direct upload
post.description: Finalizes a single-part or multipart upload, verifies the expected content identity, and queues derived processing.

get.summary: Read incremental changes for a device
get.description: Returns an ordered, opaque-cursor feed. The device header allows the server to omit Local-only assets owned by other devices.
Returns Remote media plus Local media available on the requesting device. Pagination is stable and keyset-based.
Searches filename, description, transcript, category, date, media type, and normalized location while enforcing device visibility for Local assets.
Local locators are returned only for occurrences owned by the requesting device.

post.summary: Move a media asset to recoverable trash
post.description: The asset remains recoverable for 30 days. Source manifest deletion normally applies last-occurrence semantics automatically.

post.summary: Restore a media asset from trash
Retry an actionable failed processing job
post.description: Ordinary transient failures retry automatically. This endpoint is for jobs that reached Needs attention.

post.summary: Skip scene-description work that cannot prepare a preview
post.description: Cancels a non-completed Description job and releases temporary staging and quota reservations.
The backend must verify the provider signature against the raw body before parsing. Duplicate events are acknowledged without duplicating transcript data.

get.description: Requires an ImageTracker administrator claim. The response contains service-level status only and never returns credentials, DSNs, bucket keys, or provider secrets.
Placeholder for read-only schema, queue, deduplication, processing, and legacy-migration checks. It performs no repair or migration.

CognitoBearer.description: Amazon Cognito access token for the ImageTracker user pool.

AdminBearer.description: The same Cognito access token with the ImageTracker administrator claim.

IdempotencyReplayedHeader.description: True when the response was replayed from a prior identical mutation.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Client-generated key scoped to the signed-in user and operation. Reuse is valid only with an identical request body and target.

DeviceIdHeader.name: X-ImageTracker-Device-Id
DeviceIdHeader.description: Registered calling device used to enforce Local-media visibility.

CursorQuery.name: cursor
CursorQuery.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by the previous page. Clients must not parse or construct it.

ElevenLabsSignatureHeader.name: elevenlabs-signature
ElevenLabsSignatureHeader.description: ElevenLabs HMAC signature. Verification is performed against the unmodified request body.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or a cursor is invalid.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication or provider signature verification failed.

Forbidden.description: The caller is authenticated but cannot access the resource.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current state or idempotency history.

Unprocessable.description: The request is syntactically valid but violates resource rules.

RateLimited.description: The request is rate limited or deferred by a hard quota.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required dependency is temporarily unavailable.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code such as INVALID_CURSOR or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

sourceKey.description: Opaque stable client-generated identity for this library or folder. Local paths must not be used as the key.

localLocator.description: Device-local reference. It is returned only to the owning device.

contentSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the exact original bytes.

capturedAtLocal.description: ISO 8601 local wall-clock value without an implied time zone.

ManifestUpsertEntry.description: Creates or updates a source occurrence while preserving its exact filename. contentSha256 may arrive in a later batch.

deletionDetectionReliable.description: Must be false when permission is limited/revoked or the source could not be read completely.

descriptionJobId.description: One per-asset scene-description job. Present only while the photo lacks a current successful description. Duplicate occurrences share the same job ID.

UploadPurpose.description: Original and Preview are durable only for Remote sources. TemporaryProcessing is short-lived staging for an authorized enrichment job and does not change Local storage mode.

assetContentSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the exact original bytes used for per-user MediaAsset identity and deduplication.

objectSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the specific object bytes being uploaded. It equals assetContentSha256 for an original but differs for generated previews.

objectMimeType.description: MIME type of the specific uploaded object.

objectByteSize.description: Byte size of the specific uploaded object.

processingJobId.description: Required when purpose is TemporaryProcessing. The job must belong to this user and asset and be eligible for provider submission.

headers.description: Headers that must be sent exactly as supplied, including the S3 checksum header.
Headers that must be sent exactly as supplied, including x-amz-checksum-sha256 for this part.

checksumType.description: Multipart transport integrity is validated by S3 using per-part SHA-256 values and its composite checksum. It is separate from the exact whole-object assetContentSha256.

checksumSha256.description: Base64-encoded SHA-256 of this exact part. The server binds it into the signed S3 request headers.

UploadPlan.description: Signed upload data is present only when disposition is UploadRequired. Local sources receive LocalOnly for Original or Preview. An authorized Local TemporaryProcessing request receives short-lived staging upload data without making the asset remotely available. An already stored durable hash receives AlreadyStored.

checksumSha256.description: Base64-encoded SHA-256 returned for the uploaded part and supplied to S3 multipart completion.

objectSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the completed object bytes. The server compares this to the UploadSession checksum before finalization.

contentSha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the exact original bytes.

localLocator.description: Present only when the occurrence belongs to the requesting device.

cursor.description: Opaque position after this individual change.

data.description: Provider payload retained only as needed for correlation and normalized immediately.
